failed_or_abandoned: Stream-grid Delta-eta approach (P034-style kernels x WimPyDD/analytic Delta-eta on a 0.5 km/s v_min grid): rejected before use because the grid quantisation is comparable to the 0.24 km/s diurnal shift; replaced by the exact O1 factorisation dR/dE = sum_A C_A(E) eta(v_min,A) with the analytic eta at the exact lab speed (validated to 0.01-1.6 % against WimPyDD's day halo).
Two trivial script errors fixed before the first complete run (invalid dict-key names with hyphens; a cluttered savetxt line).
P085 (exact Earth velocity) does not exist yet; the ephemeris comparison was therefore done here against P055 and wimprates.
